liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (3 reviews): Opening the second set, it set the tone; reviewer calls it a new personal favorite; Starts rocky, then the band settles into a deep, spacey groove leading into Playin' [9][10][18]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds it intense: echo on Bob's vocal opens it, and Brent's playing stands out; Attendee stood in the aisle about ten rows back, Jerry's side, and was blown away [8][16]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Reviewer singles it out as sounding awesome on this copy [13]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer says even this one comes out tripped-out and spacey [13]
- **Space** (1 review): Quiet space intro leading into The Other One and then China Doll is praised [18]
- Long jam in which Jerry sounds coherent; second set runs only about 75 minutes [10]
- Runs 23:25, not counting the reprise [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-04-19 s1 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t02 Feel Like A Stranger**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t03 Stagger Lee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t04 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t05 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t06 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t07 Big Railroad Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd86-04-19 s1 t08 One More Saturday Night**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-19.140200.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 126 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1986-04-19.sbd.miller.34419.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 122 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: The cassette flips a few seconds into Space [2]
- **gd86-04-19.sbd.candyman.8568.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 119 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer reports excellent sound quality on this soundboard; Reviewer describes the soundboard as very crisp; Reviewer calls the soundboard sparkling [9][11][17]
- **gd1986-04-19.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-34764.82049.flac16**: soundboard; 2 songs; 14 min [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls Jerry looking awful in 1986 because of his declining health [11]
- Attendee recalls cups of strange liquid circulating after set one, with warnings to be careful [16]
- Short, mesmerizing, spacey second set; reviewer says it is unlike typical 1986 shows [13]
- Reviewer says most shows before Jerry's 1986 coma are very short [17]
- Show runs just over two hours, short for the era, especially the second set [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-19.140200.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 > Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk > Adobe Audition… [1]
- **gd1986-04-19.sbd.miller.34419.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) D [2]
- **gd86-04-19.sbd.candyman.8568.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> WAV> SHN [5]
- **gd1986-04-19.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-34764.82049.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Bill Tetzeli; source: SHNID 34764 patched with SHNID 34419 [7]. Also: Dropouts in Sugar Magnolia and Quinn on the PCM seed were patched using the master soundboard cassette; Cassette patches were phase-inverted, lowered 1.3 dB, and pitch-stretched to match; edited in Cool Edit Pro [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [21]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-04-22 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA. - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-04-22-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca/) [22]
